name: Cable Single-Arm Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low cable and rest your working upper arm on the pad with the handle in your upturned palm.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Lower it under control until your elbow is nearly straight.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your shoulder from lifting as your hand approaches it.
Keep the back of your upper arm flat on the pad and stop just short of locking out.
